summary: Canada's church-run, state-funded residential schools forcibly removed Indigenous children from 1883 to 1996 to erase their cultures, subjecting them to beatings, sexual abuse, forced labour and deaths numbering in the thousands.

evidence.note: 1857 Gradual Civilization Act and enfranchisement scheme discussed at length as the precursor policy
Macdonald sends journalist Davin to Washington to study US industrial boarding schools
Grant's aggressive civilization policy and the Black Hills war, the US model Canada copied
Anglican and Catholic churches run the schools and compete for Indigenous pupils
schools run from 1883 until the last closes in 1996
disease deaths, mass graves and the estimated toll of 3,200 to over 6,000 children
Starr's career from 1956, Gordon Residence from 1968, arrest and 1993 guilty plea
survivor lawsuits, the 2008 apology and the Truth and Reconciliation Commission running to 2015
1940s-50s nutrition experiments on malnourished pupils, revealed in 2013

notes: Transcript dates the British North America Act to 1876; it was 1867 (the Indian Act is 1876). Starr's birth and death years are unknown to me, so floruit 1968 (Gordon Residence appointment). british-empire polity covers the pre-1867 colonial laws; drop it if the reviewer prefers. Medical experiments and child labour got about a minute each, so no medical-malpractice or labour themes.
